description: Update a map's top-level properties (name, display name, bgm, encounters, etc.). Does not repaint tiles. Cannot change width/height (that would desync the tile data array) — use resize_map for that. The echo omits the tile `data` array and the `events` map (neither is touched here) and reports dataTileCount/eventCount instead; pass verbose: true or use get_map for the full record.

dryRun.description: Preview only: return a diff of what would change without writing to disk.

verbose.description: Echo the full written record instead of the default summary. Off by default: the response reports identity, counts and command-list shape, which is what you would assert on, and omits the parameters/conditions you would only re-read. Read the full record with the matching get_* tool.

name: update_map
